findings.explanation: The new DELETE /users/<int:user_id> endpoint is protected only by @require_auth (any authenticated user). The security policy explicitly requires the admin role for deleting a user account, and the API spec lists DELETE /users/<id> as 'admin only'. The endpoint performs no role check (no @require_role("admin") and no is_owner_or_admin check), so any authenticated user (role 'user') can delete any user account by ID. This is a missing authorization check (CWE-862).

evidence.content: Deleting a user account requires the **admin** role.

findings.suggested_fix: Add the admin role check to the endpoint, e.g. replace @require_auth with @require_role("admin") (or add @require_role("admin") in addition to @require_auth), so only administrators can delete user accounts.
